messages.subject: Project Polaris - COMPLETED
messages.plaintextBody:
Charles, Miriam, Nathan,

Delighted to confirm that Project Polaris completed this afternoon. Kingsford now owns 100% of Larkfield Spa & Wellness Limited. Cash consideration of £29.3m has been paid, £1.5m is in escrow (release 30 April 2027), and the Pennine debt has been repaid. We'll attend to stamping the transfers (£164k SDRT) and the Companies House filings next week, and will send a closing bible in due course.

Congratulations to the team.

Kind regards,

Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
+44 (0)20 7946 0012
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
